data.credibility: Management reliably meets headline revenue and margin thresholds, but routinely drops granular commitments—such as specific capex, non-defense targets, and data center revenue—without updates. Order inflow targets also show occasional slippage.

lines.line: Target >27% EBITDA margin achieved with 29.2% in FY26.
Missed >₹27,000 crore order inflow target, reporting only ₹19,300 crore in Q3.
Targeted >15% revenue growth in FY26 and delivered 16.2%.
Dropped ₹57,000 crore total FY26 order inflow target after Q2.
Dropped promised ₹1,600 crore FY26 R&D investment target without reporting actuals.
FY26 capex guidance of >₹1,000 crore was dropped after Q3.
Dropped FY26 export target of 3% to 4% of turnover after Q3.
On track to achieve 5% export turnover share within 2 to 3 years.
On track targeting over ₹2,000 crore R&D investment for FY27.
Quietly dropped target of crossing 10% non-defense turnover in the near future.
Dropped aim of ₹1,000 crore from data center business from FY27 onwards.
Dropped ongoing target of minimum 20% year-on-year growth in R&D investments.
On track for >15% FY27 revenue growth, achieving 25.8% across first two quarters.
FY27 EBITDA margin is slipping at 26.6% versus the >28% initial guidance.
Order inflow guidance of >₹55,000 crore for FY27 remains reiterated and on track.
On track with target of around ₹2,200 crore R&D spend in FY27.
Maintained capital expenditure guidance of more than ₹1,200 crore for FY27.
FY27 export order target of USD 300 million is pending following initial guidance.

bull: Revenue compounded 14.4% annually over five years, with FY27 running at 25.8% growth through two quarters.
Balance sheet remains robust with virtually zero debt: borrowings stand at ₹85 crore against net worth of ₹26,259 crore.
EBITDA margins expanded from 22.8% in FY21 to 29.2% in FY26, supporting a strong 36.4% ROCE.
bear: Operating cash flow conversion is weak, delivering only 59% of reported profit over the past five years.
Working capital days elongated significantly from 47 days to 135 days over a five-year period.
Management missed the FY26 order inflow goal of ₹27,000 crore and dropped capex and diversification targets.
